    Install

    VS Code

    Install lumora-icons-1.0.0.vsix via Extensions → … → Install from VSIX, then run Preferences: File Icon Theme and pick any Lumora edition.

    Chrome · Edge · Brave · Arc

    Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and select extensions/chrome. Switch editions from the toolbar popup.

    Color themes

    The VS Code extension also ships Lumora Midnight and Lumora Daybreak — editor themes tuned to sit behind the icons.
